The check passes on one page. The HM's 'no' rests on gaps the bank can't fill truthfully: no model training or PyTorch, and no stated U.S. Person status.
gaps: human review step for model predictions
DocQA eval-set labeling source and what each of the 12 configurations varied
constraints: Must be a U.S. Person (export-controlled access); the bank doesn't record citizenship or green card, so confirm before applying; U.S. clearance eligibility may be required
In-person 12-week internship in Santa Ana, CA, summer 2027; the resume says Seattle, so relocation goes on the form
Must return to school for at least one quarter/semester after the internship: passes (Expected Dec 2027)
dropped: shop.api (REST endpoints/schema): proves no JD requirement
gateway.redis (shared 1,000 req/s limit): a true result for throttle, but it proves no JD requirement
'tool-calling agents' from the NLP skills line: dropped so the line fits after spelling out 'Natural Language Processing (NLP)'
HM's U.S. Person / on-site line: not in the bank, belongs on the application form unless you ask for it
Skills Kubernetes, Spring Boot, gRPC, WebSockets, and the distributed-systems line: unrelated to the JD

0 of 10,000 acked writes lost, 50 SIGKILL faults (tinykv, bank kv.chaos)
80 -> 2,400 writes/s, 1 to 64 clients, 3-node cluster, 250 ms median failover (tinykv, bank kv.perf)

questions: Are you a U.S. Person (citizen, permanent resident, asylee or refugee)? If not, skip this role. If yes, do you want a one-line 'U.S. Person; able to work in person in Santa Ana, CA, Summer 2027' on the resume, as the HM suggested? It isn't in your bank, so I didn't add it.

Do you have real ML training work (PyTorch, CV/NLP models, GPU/Colab) or coursework (ML, probability, statistics, linear algebra, data structures) that isn't in the bank? The HM says this one gap decides the screen, and there are ~2.8 in free to lead with it.
Who labeled the 60-query DocQA test set, and what did the 12 configurations vary? If you add it to the bank, the lead bullet answers the HM's overfitting doubt.

Builder template (not edited): the ATS reviewer notes that right-aligned location/dates extract with no separator ('Example State University Seattle, WA') and that bullet glyphs are drawn shapes, so they don't appear in the extracted text. Should the builder add a ' | ' separator and a text bullet character?
Is 'Git' in the Tools line OK? The evidence is GitHub repos plus GitHub Actions CI that blocks merges.
warnings: 2.8 in empty at the bottom of the page: add a relevant true bullet if your bank has one
